fuel_consumption.source_quote: Aircraft fuel costs of $108,863,000 for 104,799,000 gallons used resulted in an average fuel cost of $1.04 per gallon for the year ended March 31, 2004.

instrument_type_details.notes: Two instruments at March 31, 2004: (1) Sep 2003 swap: 630K gal/month Jan-Jun 2004 at 74.50 cents/gal (~7% of requirements); (2) May 21, 2004 collar (entered after FY end): WTI crude basis, cap $39/bbl, floor $34.85/bbl, covering ~25% of Q ending Dec 31, 2004 and Mar 31, 2005. FY2004 results: unrealized derivative GAIN of $469,000; realized GAIN of $918,000 from cash settlements. Net fair value at March 31, 2004 approximately $0.469M (unrealized gain). At filing date (June 2004): ~6% hedged for Q ending June 30, 2004; May 21, 2004 collar = ~25% for Dec 2004 and Mar 2005 quarters.
